title: task_result row
description: One row per worker outcome in state/ssot/task_results.jsonl. Covers BOTH positive results and no-work receipts - a worker that finds an empty queue MUST still write a row. Silence is the failure mode this schema exists to eliminate. This is the second and last of the two schemas the factory adds.

task_id.description: Join key to task_queue.jsonl. Use the literal 'NO_WORK' when the queue was empty - the row is still REQUIRED.

model_id.description: Exact model. Provenance is per-cell, not per-vendor.

outcome.description: NO_WORK is a first-class outcome and MUST be written. A loop that ticks on an empty queue and reports nothing is the EMPTY-QUEUE REWARD HACK; this enum is the cure.

no_work_reason.description: REQUIRED when outcome is NO_WORK. 'queue empty' / 'no task matched my capabilities' / 'all matching tasks leased'. An unexplained NO_WORK is indistinguishable from a broken worker.

artifact_paths.description: Paths produced, each with a sha256 appended.

test.description: Copied VERBATIM from the queue row. It was defined before the work; it is not rewritten after.

graded_by.description: MUST NOT equal worker_id. A producer grading itself is not a verdict.

verifier_result.description: What program checked this, not what a model asserted.

consumer_ack.description: Without ConsumerAck you have produced inventory (Ratatoskr R1). This object is what turns output into an outcome.

falsifier.description: REQUIRED in spirit: a result that cannot be wrong is not evidence.

hash_rule.description: The EXACT canonicalization, stated on the row. A hash nobody can recompute is self-declared - see L_UNREPRODUCIBLE_ROW_HASH.
